title: 技術驗證｜尺度、材料、法規與施工可行性｜惠強 HQ Design
desc: 方案能不能蓋，什麼時候知道？技術驗證確認尺度、材料、法規、預算與施工可行性五項；100% 設計施工一體，驗證者就是施工者。外部設計自此接手。
h1: 方案能不能蓋，什麼時候知道？
lede: 能不能蓋、多少錢、合不合法，在進入 BIM 與施工圖之前確認，而不是在工地。
gloss: Technical Validation — dimensions, materials, regulations, budget and construction feasibility confirmed before BIM coordination.
inp: 定案設計意圖（惠強產出或外部團隊提供）、預算範圍、大樓規範與消防／機電既有條件。
out: 五項驗證結論（尺度、材料、法規、預算、施工可行性）與需調整項目清單，交 05 BIM 協調。
q: 設計圖很漂亮，但預算、法規和現場真的做得到嗎？
quote: 惠強室內裝修（HQ Design）在技術驗證階段確認五項：尺度、材料、法規、預算與施工可行性。惠強設計與施工 100% 由同一團隊完成，執行驗證的即是之後進場施工的團隊。設計意圖來自外部團隊時，惠強自此階段接手；2022 年金普頓大安酒店公共區域與客房走廊施工即為此模式。
quote2: 一般流程中「問題常在現場才被發現」；技術驗證把可行性、預算與法規的判斷提前到施工圖之前。
qen: Confirm dimensions, materials, regulations, budget and construction feasibility. Because HQ Design builds what it designs, the team validating is the team that will build.
how_h2: 惠強室內裝修在技術驗證階段確認哪五項？
how: 關鍵尺寸、淨高、材料規格與接合方式是否成立；材料工法對照既有案件紀錄。
材料工法為惠強 AI 可用資料庫的六類內容之一（設計決策、材料工法、估價與發包、施工節點、品質管理、風險控管）。
建築、機電、消防與設備界面的法規與大樓規範核對，需要調整的項目在此列出。
服務項目「機電消防整合」：建築、機電、消防與設備界面協調。
以模型與材料清單對照預算範圍，取捨在定案後、施工圖前完成。
BIM 報價整合為 2026 年 4 月導入項目；估價與發包紀錄為資料庫內容之一。
施工順序、分區與營運限制是否可執行——由之後進場的工程團隊判斷。
惠強設計施工 100% 一體化：驗證者就是施工者。
cap: 定案設計依序通過五道檢核閘門；左下虛線為外部設計意圖自此接手的路徑（金普頓大安酒店，2022）。
why_h2: 技術驗證對業主的意義是什麼？
why: 可行性、預算與法規的取捨在施工圖之前完成，不在工地。
100% 設計施工一體，判斷「做得到」的人就是之後做的人。
模型、圖面與報價依據更容易維持一致。

ev.claim_t: 外部設計意圖接手（第二委任模式）
ev.claim: 設計意圖來自外部團隊，惠強承攬公共區域與客房走廊施工，自技術驗證起負責把設計品質建造出來並可被驗收。
ev.mode: 委任模式說明 · 非 AI 流程證據

ev_foot: 金普頓大安酒店（2022）為「外部設計意圖自技術驗證接手」的委任模式證據，不作為 AI 流程證據；2024 年前完成之案件不列為 AI 流程證據。
titleEn: Technical Validation — dimensions, materials, regulations, buildability
descEn: Can the scheme be built, and when do you find out? Technical validation confirms dimensions, materials, regulations, budget and buildability. The team validating is the team that builds.
h1En: Can it be built, and when do you find out?
ledeEn: Whether it can be built, what it costs and whether it complies are confirmed before BIM and construction drawings — not on site.
inpEn: Settled design intent, whether produced by HQ Design or supplied by an external team, the budget range, building standards, and existing fire and MEP conditions.
outEn: Conclusions on five checks — dimensions, materials, regulations, budget and buildability — with a list of items to adjust, passed to stage 05 BIM Coordination.
howH2En: Which five checks does HQ Design make during technical validation?
whyH2En: What does technical validation mean for the owner?
howEn: Whether key dimensions, clear heights, material specifications and junction details hold; material and method are checked against records from earlier projects.
Architectural, MEP, fire and equipment interfaces are checked against regulations and building standards, and items needing adjustment are listed here.
The model and material schedule are checked against the budget range, so trade-offs are made after intent is settled and before construction drawings.
Whether the construction sequence, zoning and operational constraints can be executed — judged by the site team that will later carry them out.
whyEn: Feasibility, budget and regulatory trade-offs are settled before construction drawings, not on site.
The team validating is the team building
Design and construction sit in one team, so whoever judges that it can be done is whoever later does it.
Model, drawings and the basis for pricing are easier to keep aligned.
evFootEn: Kimpton Da An Hotel (2022) is evidence of the engagement model in which external design intent is taken on from technical validation. It is not evidence of AI process; projects completed before 2024 are not listed as evidence of AI process.
figAltEn: Technical validation diagram: the settled design passes five checks in turn — dimensions, materials, regulations, budget and buildability — before entering BIM coordination; external design intent is taken on from this stage.
